rawProofCommandBoundary: Hermetic in-memory proof only. It exercises the USF API contract proof, synthetic tenants, local route metadata, OpenAPI coverage, safe error envelopes, PDP denials, local idempotency, opaque cursor posture, value-free audit evidence, and explicit reclassification of public API, generated client, GraphQL, browser-session, gateway-live, staging, production, SOC, ISO certification, full dev readiness, full React parity, and USF-133 closure claims.
nonClaims: No full dev readiness, test readiness, staging readiness, production readiness, deployment readiness, live-provider readiness, SOC readiness, ISO certification, enterprise production readiness, full React parity, or USF-133 closure claim is made.

Hermetic API proof does not prove public API readiness, external developer platform readiness, generated SDK readiness, GraphQL federation readiness, browser-session readiness, gateway-live readiness, WAF readiness, TLS termination readiness, or deployed edge readiness.

Local route metadata and OpenAPI proof do not prove customer-facing compatibility guarantees, consumer-driven contract operation, browser UI operation, public unsubscribe or bulk API readiness, environment promotion, or production API operation.
The external-caddy service catalogue row and gateway-clickthrough matrix remain profile-gated local substrate evidence only; they are not equivalent to public gateway or live edge readiness.
